All objectives complete. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Ticket `c2rd1 RD Bench Ticket` created (Ref **RD-1015**, customer "Bench Test Customer", detail page `http://127.0.0.1:4180/#/tickets/t15`), initially in status Draft.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Part `c2rd1 RD Part A` added with cost $100.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$125.00** (unit price; line total $125.00 at qty 1).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Part `c2rd1 RD Part B` added with cost $200.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$250.00**. Ticket parts total at that point: $375.00.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Part A's cost edited from 100 to 150 (markup unchanged at 25%). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50**. Ticket parts total then: $437.50 ($187.50 + $250.00).

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Ticket ends in status **Ready**. The precondition the app enforces: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier assigned.** The first "Mark Ready" attempt was rejected with the verbatim alert: *"Ticket is not ready Part "c2rd1 RD Part A" has no supplier Part "c2rd1 RD Part B" has no supplier"*. I satisfied it by assigning supplier "Bench Supplier" to Part A and "Another Supplier" to Part B, after which "Mark Ready" succeeded — the status badge showed Ready and the action buttons switched to "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed".

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Both parts removed (each via a row "Delete" button plus a "Delete part" confirmation dialog); ticket parts count verified at **0**. The ticket was then archived via "Archive ticket" (no precondition blocked it from Ready status; the button changed to "Unarchive ticket"). Verified with search "c2rd1": with "Show archived" unchecked the active list shows "No tickets match the current filters"; with "Show archived" checked, RD-1015 appears with an "Archived" badge, status Ready, parts 0. Nothing created by this run remains active.
